info.title: Bartender API
info.description: API for managing sandboxes and snapshots.

Tags.description: User-defined key-value labels (both keys and values are strings).

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot the sandbox boots from. The snapshot produced when the sandbox terminates is aliased as `sandbox:<sandbox id>`.

agent.description: Connection details for the in-sandbox agent.

token.description: Null unless the sandbox is running.

url.description: Null unless the sandbox is running.

ttl.description: Seconds after creation before the sandbox is automatically terminated. Null disables automatic termination.

termination_policy.description: The termination policy, or null for an ephemeral sandbox (no snapshot is taken and it is deleted on termination).

TerminationPolicy.description: The policy applied when a sandbox terminates.

TerminationSnapshot.description: The snapshot captured when a sandbox terminates.

memory.description: When true both the filesystem and memory are snapshotted (hibernate); when false only the filesystem is snapshotted (stop).

aliases.description: Aliases to apply to the produced snapshot.

ttl.description: Seconds after which the snapshot produced on termination expires. Must be > 0. Omit to keep the snapshot indefinitely.
Seconds after creation before the snapshot is automatically retired, or null if it is kept indefinitely.

memory.description: Whether the snapshot includes a memory snapshot.

retired_at.description: When the snapshot was retired, or null if it is still active. A retired snapshot can no longer be used to create new sandboxes and is eventually deleted.

registry_url.description: Registry URL including the namespace path (e.g. registry.example.com/nbswy3dp).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; `null` when there are no more items.
Cursor for the next page; `null` when there are no more items.

product_name.description: Human-readable label for the billed product. Display-only and not stable; do not key logic off this value.

quantity.description: Total usage for the window in the product's native unit, as a decimal string.

unit_price.description: Per-unit price in USD, as a decimal string.

cost.description: Total cost for the line item in USD, as a decimal string.

pricing_dimensions.description: Rate-determining dimensions as string key-value pairs. Varies by product.

attributes.description: Resource identifiers for attribution as string key-value pairs. `api_key_id` and `project_id` are present for all line items.

date.description: The date of the time window, YYYY-MM-DD.

start_time.description: Start of the time window (UTC, ISO 8601).

end_time.description: Exclusive end of the time window (UTC, ISO 8601).

organization_id.description: The organization the usage belongs to, resolved from the API key.

earliest_window_start.description: Start of the earliest time window with usage in the month (UTC, ISO 8601), or null when the month has no usage. Describes the whole month, not the current page.

latest_window_end.description: Exclusive end of the latest time window with usage in the month (UTC, ISO 8601), or null when the month has no usage. Describes the whole month, not the current page.

data.description: Usage windows for the current page, ordered by time (ascending). Windows with no usage are omitted.

has_more.description: True when more time windows are available beyond the current page.

next_page_token.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; pass it back as `page_token`. Null when `has_more` is false.

post.summary: Authorize access to a project or container registry project

project_id.description: Project ID to authorize access to. Accepts a plain project ID (proj_* or ws_*) or a base32-encoded project ID from the container registry path.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated organization's billing usage for a single month as flat, cost-annotated line items grouped into time windows. Usage is resolved from the Bearer API key's organization.

Usage data is cached: prior months refresh roughly every 24 hours, and the current month refreshes roughly hourly (through the last completed hour at `hour` granularity, or through yesterday at `day` granularity).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Billing month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the current month. Cannot be a future month or more than 12 months in the past. Example: 2026-06

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time window size. `hour` returns roughly 24x more rows than `day`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of time windows (not line items) per page.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Valid only for the `month` and `granularity` that produced it.

post.summary: Issue a container registry credential for the authenticated user
post.description: Returns credentials (username, password, registry URL) for authenticating with the container registry. The registry URL includes the user's namespace path derived from their project ID.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Sandbox ID returned as `next_cursor` from a previous page.

parameters.name: statuses[]
parameters.description: Filter by status; matches sandboxes in any of the given statuses.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: Filter by snapshot; matches sandboxes created from the given snapshot.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tags; matches sandboxes whose tags contain all given pairs.

snapshot_id.description: ID of the snapshot to use. One of snapshot_id or snapshot_alias is required.

snapshot_alias.description: Alias of the snapshot to use. One of snapshot_id or snapshot_alias is required.

cpu.description: CPU allocation in cores. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

memory_bytes.description: Memory allocation in bytes. Must be between 1 GB and 8 GB per requested CPU. Defaults to 2 GB when omitted.

ttl.description: Seconds after creation before the sandbox is automatically terminated. Must be > 0. Omit to disable automatic termination.

tags.description: User-defined key-value labels (both keys and values are strings). Keys must be at most 59 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and dots, and must start and end with a letter or a digit.

termination_policy.description: The termination policy. Omit for an ephemeral sandbox (no snapshot, deleted on termination).

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description: List of sandbox IDs. Maximum 100, no duplicates.

200.description: List of sandboxes (preserves request order; missing IDs are omitted).

post.description: Terminates a sandbox. After this operation the sandbox cannot be used again.

snapshot.description: What this teardown snapshots, overriding the snapshot the sandbox's stored termination policy would take. Omit to keep the stored policy; null makes the teardown ephemeral (no snapshot).

post.summary: Wait for a sandbox to reach a terminal status

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Snapshot ID returned as `next_cursor` from a previous page.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tags; matches snapshots whose tags contain all given pairs.

parameters.name: exclude_retired
parameters.description: When true, retired snapshots are excluded. Defaults to false.

post.summary: Create a snapshot for a container image

image.description: Container image reference. Parsed as `[registry/][repository/]name[:tag]`, using Docker Hub and `latest` as defaults when omitted.

ttl.description: Seconds after creation before the snapshot is automatically deleted. Omit to keep the snapshot indefinitely.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description: List of snapshot UUIDs. Maximum 100, no duplicates.

200.description: List of snapshots (preserves request order; missing IDs are omitted).

post.description: Retires the snapshot. Once retired, the snapshot can no longer be used to create new sandboxes, and it is eventually deleted, provided no sandbox still references it.

post.summary: Assign an alias to a snapshot
post.description: Points the alias at the snapshot. If an alias of the same name already exists in the project, it is repointed at this snapshot (an upsert).

delete.description: Deletes the alias in the caller's project. Idempotent: succeeds whether or not the alias exists.
